The appeal path, quoted from POL-GEN-04

Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 1.05 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

The judge's explanation, as written

Both sides agree on the arithmetic, and the evidence bears them out. The governing distance is the GPS trace, 4.04 km (EV-GPS-02820); the trip record's 4.0 km is a rounded convenience copy and POL-RD-01 forbids citing it for the threshold test, so the trace figure is used. Against the booked optimal of 3.2 km (EV-TRIP-02820) the excess is 0.84 km, or 26.25% — above both POL-RD-01 limbs (greater than 0.8 km, greater than 20%), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED. It is not MATERIAL (0.84 km is far below 8.0 km, 26.25% far below 50%), so POL-RD-06 is not engaged: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 408, no pattern exists, no FULL_REFUND uplift and no conduct referral issue. Nothing exculpates the excess. The driver's answer, 'one-way streets', names no traffic advisory and no evidence ID; the only advisory, EV-ADVIS-02820-01, is MISSING at weight 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and because the driver cited no identifier for it, POL-RD-13(1) applies — the assertion is not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged, and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. The chat log (EV-CHAT-02820) holds zero messages, so POL-RD-04 has no rider instruction to excuse anything. The fare is METERED with quoted_fare_sgd null, so POL-RD-11 does not apply; there are no amended endpoints (POL-RD-05) and the vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL (POL-RD-12). The refund is therefore arithmetic under POL-RD-02: charged_total 9.70 less recomputed_fare 8.68 — (3.80 base + 0.75 × 3.2 km + 0.28 × 6.0 min) × the 1.0 surge multiplier read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, plus the 0.80 platform fee — giving 1.02, rounded up to 1.05. That is above the 0.50 de-minimis floor and 10.5% of charged_total, well short of the 90% that would make it a full refund. There are no ERP, toll or surcharge lines, so POL-RD-09 adds nothing and nothing is double-counted. The GPS trace is unimpaired under POL-RD-07 (46 fixes at 10-second intervals, no gaps, 100.0% coverage), so no POL-RD-10(3) escalation arises and no independent corroboration is needed. No other POL-RD-10 trigger fires: identifiers and timestamps match and run in order, and no charge line lacks a counterpart. The monetary effect of 1.05 SGD is below the 8.00 SGD execution threshold and is executed automatically. The rider's alternative argument about the driver's uncited traffic assertion was discarded for not naming the impairment issue code, but the outcome above is reached on the surviving claims; the rider is refunded 1.05 SGD and no driver compensation is payable, because the billed distance (4.0 km) falls short of the trace (4.04 km) by only 0.04 km, far under the 1.0 km POL-RD-04 threshold. The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

What each side argued

The rider advocate

kept The measured excess on this trip's own trace is 0.84 km: gps_trace.trace_distance_km is 4.04 km against the booked optimal of 3.2 km recorded on the trip record, which is 26.25% of optimal. Both limbs of the POL-RD-01 establishment test therefore pass — 0.84 km is greater than the 0.8 km absolute threshold, and 26.25% is greater than the 20% proportional threshold. The route deviation is ESTABLISHED on this trip's evidence.

evidence EV-GPS-02820, EV-TRIP-02820 · clauses POL-RD-01

kept The governing distance field is the trace figure, not the trip record's rounded convenience copy. trip_record.actual_distance_km is 4.0 km, which yields exactly 0.80 km of excess — not greater than 0.8 km — and would fail the absolute limb outright. POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km governing precisely because these two fields straddle the threshold, and it expressly forbids citing actual_distance_km for the threshold test. The 4.04 km trace figure is the only admissible measure here.

evidence EV-GPS-02820, EV-TRIP-02820 · clauses POL-RD-01

kept Because the deviation is established and nothing excuses it, the refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02 on a METERED fare. recomputed_fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 x 3.2 km optimal + 0.28 x 6.0 min optimal) x the 1.0 surge multiplier read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, plus the 0.80 platform fee = 8.68 SGD. charged_total is 9.70 SGD, so the refund is 9.70 - 8.68 = 1.02 SGD, rounded up to the payable 1.05 SGD. The fare ledger's own derived money block records 1.0200 before rounding and 1.05 payable, and there is no ERP or fixed surcharge to add.

evidence EV-FARE-02820, EV-TRIP-02820, EV-GPS-02820 · clauses POL-RD-02

kept That refund is above the 0.50 SGD de-minimis floor (the ledger's own below_de_minimis flag is false) and is 10.5% of charged_total, far below the 90% share that would make it a FULL_REFUND. The only outcome the arithmetic licenses is PARTIAL_REFUND of 1.05 SGD to the rider.
